new_task_1.title: Remove deprecated pytest.Package.gethookproxy() and pytest.Package.isinitpath() forwarding methods
new_task_1.description: The pytest.Package collector no longer defines the deprecated gethookproxy() and isinitpath() instance methods that previously forwarded to the session while emitting a deprecation warning. Plugins or custom collectors that still call these methods on Package instances will now fail with AttributeError and must switch to using the session methods directly.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure plugin and custom collector code no longer depends on pytest.Package.gethookproxy() or pytest.Package.isinitpath(), because these deprecated compatibility methods have been removed from pytest.Package in 7.4.0.

expectation.grounded: The Package class must no longer expose gethookproxy(fspath) or isinitpath(path). Code that needs the same behavior must call self.session.gethookproxy(...) and self.session.isinitpath(...) instead of going through the Package instance.
expectation.conceptual: Consumers extending or interacting with pytest.Package should treat hook-proxy lookup and init-path checks as session responsibilities rather than Package methods.

constraints.grounded: No compatibility shim remains on Package for these two methods. Existing code paths that invoked the methods for their previous forwarding behavior must be updated by consumers outside pytest.
constraints.conceptual: This is a breaking API removal for users relying on the deprecated Package surface, even though the replacement behavior is still available through session.

behavior: Calling gethookproxy() on a pytest.Package instance is no longer supported because the method has been removed.
Calling isinitpath() on a pytest.Package instance is no longer supported because the method has been removed.
Equivalent behavior remains available through the Package instance's session object via session.gethookproxy(...) and session.isinitpath(...).
acceptance_criteria: When plugin or custom collector code attempts to call package.gethookproxy(...), it must be treated as unsupported in 7.4.0 and migrated to package.session.gethookproxy(...).
When plugin or custom collector code attempts to call package.isinitpath(...), it must be treated as unsupported in 7.4.0 and migrated to package.session.isinitpath(...).
The Package public API in 7.4.0 no longer includes these deprecated forwarding methods.
